question: Which generic authorization contract should native clients use to fetch gateway-managed assistant media after setup-code pairing, without retaining or reusing shared owner/admin credentials?
rationale: The branch cannot safely choose between device-authenticated endpoint access, a narrowly scoped media credential, or a different transport contract; this choice affects all paired native clients and the gateway security boundary.

options.title: Add device-scoped media authorization
options.body: Define an authenticated gateway media request contract bound to the paired device identity and use it from native clients.

options.title: Issue short-lived scoped media credentials
options.body: Have the gateway mint a narrowly scoped, expiring credential for a specific media request or session rather than reuse an operator credential.

options.title: Use a non-HTTP attachment transport
options.body: Carry managed media through an already device-authenticated gateway protocol path if that better preserves the existing pairing boundary.

recommendation.title: Add device-scoped media authorization
recommendation.body: Define an authenticated gateway media request contract bound to the paired device identity and use it from native clients.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is assigned to the PR at the point where the unresolved generic authorization choice was documented.
